stories.subject: Anderson .Paak and Cordae Heavy Is the Crown release and Los Angeles pop-up
stories.summary: Heavy Is the Crown is scheduled for Oct. 23, with the Complex LA pop-up offering first listens and a meet-and-signing.

stories.subject: Dame Dash life-rights bankruptcy auction
stories.summary: Everlasting Films won the Oct. 1 auction at $550,000 for worldwide life-story rights and related archival material, with proceeds going to creditors.

stories.subject: Kevin Gates catalog-sale proceeds in Dreka Gates divorce order
stories.summary: The reported order directs $929,341.50 in support plus a $150,000 direct payment to Dreka, with other allocations for legal and mediation costs.

stories.subject: 2027 Grammy first-round voting closes with A$AP Rocky in contention
stories.summary: First-round voting ran through Oct. 22; early coverage identifies A$AP Rocky as a contender, and nominations are scheduled for Nov. 16.

stories.subject: Rockstar's first GTA VI television commercial
stories.summary: A first TV spot recuts the launch trailer for broadcast and keeps the Nov. 19 PS5 and Xbox Series X|S release at the center of Rockstar's campaign.

note: Every story was checked against at least two current reputable or primary sources. Legal and awards-season claims are explicitly qualified where they remain reported or pending.
